name: force the tank empty and the engine flaming out
eval: window.__BO.forceFuel=0; window.__BO.forceEmpty=true; window.__BO.forceFizzle=0.4; setParam('autorefill',0); applyForces(); paintFuel(); window.__BO.fuelFrame()

name: FUEL EMPTY is drawn in RED (peak red-dominant pixels in the title band)
eval: (function(){let best=0;const y=Math.floor(crt.height*0.42)-7;for(let k=0;k<25;k++){const d=ctx.getImageData(0,y,crt.width,14).data;let red=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){if(d[i]>80&&d[i]>d[i+2]+35)red++;}if(red>best)best=red;}return best+' red-dominant pixels';})()

name: and it BLINKS - same band over 40 frames, looking for both states
eval: (async()=>{const y=Math.floor(crt.height*0.42)-7;let lo=1e9,hi=0;for(let k=0;k<40;k++){await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));const d=ctx.getImageData(0,y,crt.width,14).data;let red=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){if(d[i]>80&&d[i]>d[i+2]+35)red++;}if(red<lo)lo=red;if(red>hi)hi=red;}return 'dimmest '+lo+', brightest '+hi+' -> '+((hi>lo*3&&hi>100)?'BLINKING':'NOT BLINKING');})()

name: hold it bright for the shot
eval: (async()=>{const y=Math.floor(crt.height*0.42)-7;for(let k=0;k<70;k++){await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(r));const d=ctx.getImageData(0,y,crt.width,14).data;let red=0;for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){if(d[i]>80&&d[i]>d[i+2]+35)red++;}if(red>300)return 'caught it lit at '+red;}return 'never caught lit';})()
